steps.eval: window.__hang = (index, prefixLen) => { const line = document.querySelectorAll('.cm-line')[index]; const walker = document.createTreeWalker(line, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT); const rects = []; for (let n = walker.nextNode(); n; n = walker.nextNode()) { for (let i = 0; i < n.length; i++) { const r = document.createRange(); r.setStart(n, i); r.setEnd(n, i + 1); const b = r.getClientRects()[0]; if (b) rects.push({ left: b.left, top: b.top }); } } const first = rects[prefixLen]; const lefts = []; let last = first.top; for (const r of rects.slice(prefixLen)) { if (r.top > last + 5) { lefts.push(r.left); last = r.top; } } return { firstLeft: first.left, wrappedLefts: lefts, contentLeft: line.getBoundingClientRect().left }; }; true

expect.eval: (() => { const e = window.__hang(0, 2); return e.wrappedLefts.length >= 1 && e.wrappedLefts.every((l) => Math.abs(l - e.firstLeft) <= 2) && e.firstLeft - e.contentLeft > 5; })()

steps.note: 箇条書き（-）: 折り返した行の左端が 1 行目の本文に揃う（±2px）
